desc: Meredith stands next to Michael in front of the whiteboard at the office, as he lightly moving her away from him.
Ryan sits in a meeting, staring at the phone in his hand, while others sit around him watching something.
Michael slowly paces back and forth around the office, speaking into a voice recorder.
Erin works at the reception desk while a man in a suit sits waiting on the couch behind her.
Andy sits sideways at his desk with his legs crossed, thinking, with a shelf of office supplies behind him.
Michael puts his finger in his mouth, mock-shooting himself with a finger gun.
A shot of Creed sitting deep in thought, with Kevin tilted back in his chair behind him, tossing something above his head.
A shot of Kevin doing sit-ups, seen through a window with blinds.
A man in a suit with a black suitcase grabs his coat from a coat rack, knocking it over.
Michael, in a suit, is standing in front of people at the office, taking a card out of his pocket.
Dwight and Michael sit closely together, staring at the computer screen with an open email on it.
Michael reaches for the phone on his desk, when Andy suddenly rips the cord out of it.
Andy, dressed as a mechanic, drives up to the parking lot where Dwight and Michael wait.
Andy, dressed as a mechanic, sitting at the restaurant table with Michael, is smelling a tire iron.
Andy is covering up the tire iron with a napkin at the restaurant.
Dwight pours a worm out of a brown package onto the restaurant table.
A man in a suit walks into the restaurant as a woman points him toward Michael's table.
A man in a suit gestures with his hand, showing the waitress where to sit.
A close-up of Kevin looking down, anxious and nervous, mouth slack, blinds visible behind him.
Dwight and Michael review flyers with a man at the restaurant table, while Andy, dressed as a mechanic, leans back drinking.
A man in a suit slams the restaurant table, making Dwight, Michael, and Andy jump in fright.
Andy, dressed as a mechanic, holds jumper cables at a car as a woman and boy watch.
Andy causes sparks to fly from the car while working with cables under the open hood.
Andy, dressed as a mechanic, stands awkwardly with his arms crossed as smoke rises from the open hood of a car behind him.
A woman and boy watch with concern as smoke rise from a car in a parking lot.
A man in a suit and glasses hands Michael a document and a pen at the restaurant table.
Michael, Dwight, and Andy, dressed as a mechanic, walk past a fountain outside a restaurant plaza with serious expressions.
Michael and Dwight get in the car as a tow truck driver talks to the woman and boy behind them.
A shot through blinds of Oscar standing with his head inside the open office fridge as Michael walks in.
Dwight looks happily disbelieving while Andy, beside him, holds his hands together, shocked, in the office with blinds and a desk lamp behind them.
Kevin leans back with his feet up on his desk, chewing colorful candy from an open jar next to a football.
